integrity: Unbounded claims follow from the explicit symbolic proof. Finite code provides only regression checks. The small-offset \(r=3\) case includes \((k,n)=(2,8)\), absent from the focal paper's printed list. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Below the cubic bound, a complete list of finite exceptional solutions for arbitrary fixed \(r\ge4\) is not supplied. The cubic bound is sharp as a uniform rule across infinitely many offsets; it is not claimed optimal separately for every \(r\).
title: Exact escape families and a sharp cubic cutoff for shifted rational-perfect numbers
